text.en:
The DSWD shall exercise oversight function over the NCRFW
without prejudice to the undertaking of their respective functions.
PGRy Hologram • 30519

2

All orders, issuances, rules and regulations or parts thereof
inconsistent with the provisions of this Executive Order are hereby repealed or
modified accordingly.

This Executive (rder shall take effect immediately.
DONE in the City of Manila, this 10th day of
our Lord, Two Thousand and Five.
May, in the year of
POMP Hologram • 30520
By the President:
EDUARDO R. ERMITA
Executive Secretary
